Name: Flower Farm Cave
Author: lala92876
Description:
This is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10506]Farm Cave Framework[/url] that lets Demetrius grow flowers in farm cave (I know it’s weird, but whatever), producing flowers every day. There’s also a Dehydrator in the cave, since I figured some people might have installed some Flower Artisan Goods mods :D

This mod adds a machine called Flower Tub. I’m not great at drawing, and I figured everyone has their own favorite retexture mods, so I’ve reused the vanilla Tub o’ Flowers sprite. Any mod that changes its appearance will also change the appearance of the Flower Tub!
Enable “Craftable Flower Tub” in the config to purchase the recipe at the Flower Dance for 2,000g or at the Oasis for 3,000g. If crafting Flower Tubs feels too unbalanced but you still want to keep the option enabled, you can adjust how many days they take to grow flowers in the config :)

The flower tub can produce six flowers from Pierre’s:
[b]Tulip[/b], [b]Blue Jazz[/b], [b]Summer Spangle[/b], [b]Poppy[/b], [b]Sunflower[/b], and [b]Fairy Rose[/b]
And also includes four forageable flowers:
[b]Sweet Pea[/b], [b]Crocus[/b], [b]Daffodil[/b], and [b]Dandelion[/b]. (I consider the last two flowers. You can use ZoeyHoshi’s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25619]Vanilla Forage Crops and Bushes[/url] to change their in-game category to flower.)
Forageable flowers can be disabled in the config

About Compatibility
I’ll consider adding compatibility with other flower mods, but I’ll need to obtain permission first to ensure everything aligns with the original authors’ intentions
[b]Thanks to PlatinumCats for granting permission! Compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16999]Quaint Living 2[/url] has now been added.[/b] Flower Tubs can produce flowers from QL2 sold by Pierre! (I think flowers sold by Sandy showing up in the cave would be a little weird) Remember to enable it in the config
[b]Thanks to 6480 for granting permission! Compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url] has been added.[/b] Flower Tubs can now produce flowers from Cornucopia sold by Pierre and Marnie! (Including every flower would be weird and pretty unbalanced.) Remember to enable it in the config

[b]Thanks to Aedenthorn for creating the framework![/b]
To change your cave type in an existing save, enable ResetEvent in Farm Cave Framework’s config

這是以 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10506]Farm Cave Framework[/url] 為基礎做的內容包，讓迪馬崔斯在農場洞穴裡培育花朵（我知道這很奇怪但隨便我只是想找個理由讓我的農場洞穴長花），會每天生成花。洞穴裡還有一台烘乾機，我想有些人可能會擁有和烘乾機相關的花藝品模組 :D

在遊戲中增加了一個名為花卉桶的機器，我不太會畫畫而且我想每個人都有自己喜好的模組，所以我直接引用了原版遊戲中一簇鮮花的圖片。只要是會更改它的模組都會一併更改花卉桶的樣子！
在設定中開啟可製作花卉桶後可以在花舞節以 2000G 或是在綠洲以 3000G 購買配方，如果覺得開啟後過於不平衡又想保留可製作花卉桶的話也可以在設定中調整生長所需的時間 :)

花卉桶可生成皮耶爾售賣的六種花：
[b]鬱金香[/b]、[b]藍調爵士[/b]、[b]夏日閃閃[/b]、[b]罌粟花[/b]、[b]向日葵[/b]、[b]仙女玫瑰[/b]
以及可採集的四種花：
[b]香豌豆[/b]、[b]番紅花[/b]、[b]黃水仙[/b]、[b]蒲公英[/b]（我覺得後兩者是花，你可以使用 ZoeyHoshi 的 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25619]Vanilla Forage Crops and Bushes [/url]讓它們在遊戲內的類別變成花）
可採集花卉可以在設定中關閉生成

關於相容性
我會考慮追加與不同花卉模組的相容性，不過我得先獲得授權確保一切都在原作者的預期之中
[b]感謝 PlatinumCats 的授權！已追加和 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16999]Quaint Living 2[/url] 的相容[/b]，現在花卉桶可以產生 QL2 中由皮耶爾售賣的花了！（我覺得在洞穴中出現由沙蒂販售的花有點詭異）記得在設定中開啟
[b]感謝 6480 的授權！已追加和 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url] 的相容[/b]， 現在花卉桶可以產生 Cornucopia 中由皮耶爾和瑪妮售賣的花了！（全部生成的話很詭異也很不平衡）記得在設定中開啟

[b]繁體中文使用者請將 [CP] FCF Flower Cave\i18n 中的 zh.json 刪除，並將 zh - traditional.json 重新命名為  zh.json[/b]

[b]感謝 Aedenthorn 創建了框架！[/b]
如果想在已有的存檔內更換洞穴的話去 Farm Cave Framework 的設定裡勾選 ResetEvent 即可
